claims.mechanism: The repeated, fronted إياك relationally narrows ع ب د B003 worship and submissive obedience to the same addressee invoked and praised earlier, so the turn to direct address converts prior naming, lordship, and dominion into the community's exclusive pledged service.

source_links.notes: Supplies the invoked-name, obedience, fronting, and praise-to-practice topology.
Preserves the finding's exclusive-allegiance component separately from its enabling-aid component.

claims.mechanism: Pairing service with ع و ن B001 help makes the relation one of backed dependence: aid from the same addressee enables and sustains service, while the standard run's ownership and subjugation material adds the compatible refinement that this dependence is supported rather than abandoned or reduced to naked domination.

source_links.notes: Adds the ownership, subjugation, supported-dependence, and preserved-agency layer.
Preserves the finding's enabling-aid component separately from its exclusive-allegiance component.

claims.mechanism: The immediate straight-path request activates ع ب د B005 physical smoothing and making-passable: worshipful service becomes material path-work that disciplines the travelers and prepares, treads, or keeps inhabitable the route for which guidance is requested.

source_links.notes: Preserves the road-smoothing component separately from the finding's claim that aid supplies power to move.
Retrospectively identifies the straight path as the activator of the road-smoothing branch.
Supplies the material analogy of repeated service as bodily inhabiting and treading a passable road.
Retrospectively identifies the straight path as the decisive activator of service as road-smoothing.

claims.mechanism: Immediately before the straight-path request, seeking aid becomes a request for the capacity to move on the route: the standard run's ع و ن B001 assistance supplies power to proceed, while the eleven-ayah run refines this through ع و ن B005 settled build and strength activated by ق و م B002 and B008, bringing the travelers into upright, even alignment without directional collapse.

source_links.notes: Preserves the finding's aid-for-movement component separately from its road-smoothing service component.
Adds the settled-strength and upright-alignment material account of how aid enables movement.
Retrospectively identifies the straight path as activating aid's settled-strength image.

claims.mechanism: The later anger contrast activates ع ب د B008 prideful aversion against ع ب د B003 submissive worship, so exclusive service becomes affective discipline that reverses self-assertive refusal and protects against a pride-anger orientation toward the wrong route.

source_links.notes: Supplies the inner reversal from offended pride and anger to submissive service.
Retrospectively identifies 1:7's anger contrast as the activator of the pride-aversion branch.
